newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINLAND TO SET UP DEFENCE MATERIAL COMPANY - GOVT.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND TO SET UP DEFENCE MATERIAL COMPANY - GOVT.

text.p: The government will organise state-owned defence material industry units into a new company, Suomen Puolustusvaline Oy, the Ministry of Trade and Industry said in a statement on Tuesday.
"The new company will function as a parent company for the defence material industry," it said.
The company's annual net sales will be 700-800 million markka, and it will consist of Vihtavuori Oy, Vammas Oy, Lapua Oy and Finavitec Oy (former Valmet Aviation), the ministry said.
The target is to benefit from the companies' synergies, improve their profitability and boost their marketing resources, it said.
The transfer of the companies will need the approval of parliament, which will be requested in connection with the second supplementary 1996 budget, the ministry said.
